title: Shadow validation: read-only docs probe
objective: Confirm the executor can acquire a lease via the Dispatcher and report a read-only fact without modifying any files or state.
scope: Read exactly one file under workspaceRoots and report its absolute path, line count, and sha256 hex digest.
acceptance: Report contains the absolute file path, a non-zero line count, and a sha256 hex digest.
No files were created, modified, or deleted during execution.
No production services were changed; no publish/push/merge occurred.
